en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sindy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Hannan, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Imamate is not correct except for a man in whom there are three characteristics – piety detaining him<sup>asws</sup> from disobeying Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and forbearance he<sup>asws</sup> can control his<sup>asws</sup> anger with, and good guardianship upon the ones he<sup>asws</sup> rules over until he<sup>asws</sup> happens to be like the merciful father to them’.
And in another report: ‘Until he<sup>asws</sup> happens to be to the citizens like the merciful father’.
